translations.web: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.
translations.bsb: For the sake of Your word and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and revealed it to Your servant.
translations.kjv: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.
translations.asv: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou wrought all this greatness, to make thy servant know it.
